_meta.title: OpenConstruction Data Agent — benchmark golden set (SEED)
_meta.status: SEED — authoritative ground truth is OWNED & VERIFIED by OC_DATA_1.
_meta.purpose: Deterministic, no-LLM-judge evaluation of the reference baseline (window.OCDataAgent.runBenchmark). Scored on C4-SELECTED.

schema.cases[].need: HARD constraints — facet values MUST use OC_DATA_1 ids: modality ∈ data/agent-taxonomy.json modality_buckets ids (point_cloud, ground_rgb, aerial_rgb, satellite_rgb, bim, drawing, tabular, text, video, depth, thermal, gpr, sensor, geospatial, hyperspectral); license ∈ {any, commercial_ok}
schema.cases[].q: SOFT natural-language text — used only for ranking tie-breaks, never as a hard constraint
schema.cases[].expect: dataset id/title substrings that SHOULD be C4-selected (case-insensitive). Empty => must abstain.
schema.cases[].fitnessExpect: (optional, OC_DATA_1) {datasetId, verdict} to score C3 fitness-accuracy

_meta.integrity: Modality ids reconciled to OC_DATA_1's agent-taxonomy.json (2026-06-19). Discovery/abstention cases reference titles present in the catalog (cross-checked vs eval-queries.json). Task-constrained, license-constrained and per-dataset fitness-verdict cases are LEFT TO OC_DATA_1 (see _oc_data_1_todo) — no unverified per-dataset facts asserted here.
